title: platformStatus
responsibility: Maps platform declarations to labels and icons for the two platform views.

inputs.name: platformStatus.platform
inputs.description: The selected revision’s platform declaration; undefined yields the Not recorded state.

outputs.name: platformViews
outputs.description: Stable target identifiers, display names and icons for Web, iOS, Android and Desktop (Electron).

outputs.name: unrecorded
outputs.description: Notice used when a revision has no recorded platform configuration.

outputs.name: platformStatus
outputs.description: The declaration’s status identifier and human-readable label. This describes repository configuration, not a live deployment verdict.
